items.Title: Architectural Assistant
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Design Expertise

Delivers high quality design work, developing creative and innovative thinking.


Project Delivery

Demonstrates an awareness of the design process and project brief, taking a supporting role in the delivery of project milestones.  

Coordinates aspects of third party work, including external contractors, suppliers and other professionals.

Delivers good quality work in line with instructions given.

 

Team Membership

Acts as a team player, responding to feedback and demonstrating a positive attitude towards work and team activities, both within the studio and across studios.

 

Client Relationships

Demonstrates and understanding of the client/practice relationship.

Builds an understanding of market trends and requirements.

 

Budget Control

Completes work in a timely and efficient manner.  

Submits accurate timesheet data in line with deadlines set.

 

Others

Provide ad-hoc support as required.
items.ShortDescriptionStr: As an Architectural Assistant you undertake aspects of the project at various stages, under the guidance of the project leader.
